about.title: About us
about.subtitle: A Sunday school built on community, knowledge and joy.
about.storyBody: Islamskole Bærum is a Sunday school for Muslim children in Bærum. We offer a coherent 12-year curriculum for children aged 6 to 18, with 8-12 students per class. Our goal is for children to get to know other Muslim children, build friendships and learn about their religion in a safe and playful environment.
about.approachBody: We combine Quran, Arabic and Islamic knowledge with play, conversation and teamwork. Teaching is grouped by age and adapted to each level, so every child experiences mastery. Community is at the heart of it: children learn together, play together and grow together.
about.communityBody: For many children, Sundays with us are a steady anchor where they meet friends who share their faith. That creates safety, belonging and joy that lasts all week.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.subtitle: We would love to hear from you. Reach out by email or drop by.

teacher.title: Become a teacher with us
teacher.subtitle: Want to share knowledge, work with children and give back to the community? We would love to hear from you.
teacher.introBody: As a teacher or volunteer at Islamskole Bærum you help give children a safe and playful start to their journey in faith and knowledge. You do not need to be an expert, just willing to contribute and be a good role model.

community.title: Give back to the community
community.body: You become an important part of a warm environment where children, families and volunteers grow together.

knowledge.title: Share your knowledge
knowledge.body: Whether it is Quran, Arabic or Islamic knowledge, you get to share what you know with curious children.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.subtitle: Terms for enrollment and payment at Islamskole Bærum.

sections.heading: Introduction
body: These terms of sale apply to enrollment in the teaching and activities offered by Islamskole Bærum through islamskole.no.
The agreement is made between you as a consumer and Islamskole Bærum as the seller. To enroll you must be 18 or have consent from a guardian.

sections.heading: Prices
body: The school fee is NOK 5,000 per child per school year. NOK 2,000 is paid on enrollment, and the remainder is due by 15 August and 15 December, or monthly by agreement with the school.
All prices are in Norwegian kroner (NOK) and include all charges. Any additional costs are stated before you complete your enrollment.

sections.heading: Payment
body: Payment is made with Vipps on enrollment. The amount shown is charged immediately when you approve the payment in Vipps. Later installments are paid via payment links sent to you.
Payment confirms that the enrollment was received. Class placement is handled separately and depends on capacity. You receive a confirmation by email.

sections.heading: Delivery
body: The service is delivered as teaching at Skuiveien 40, 1339 Vøyenenga during the stated school year (August to June).
Once the school has confirmed a place, the paid enrollment applies to the stated school year.

sections.heading: Right of withdrawal and cancellation
body: You may cancel your enrollment and receive a full refund at any time before the school year starts.
After teaching has started, the amount paid is not refunded.
Cancellations are sent to baerum@islamskole.no. Refunds are paid to the same payment method within a reasonable time.

sections.heading: Complaints
body: If there is a fault or defect in the service, you can complain by contacting us at baerum@islamskole.no.
The complaint should be sent within a reasonable time after you discovered the fault. We handle it as quickly as possible.

sections.heading: Privacy
body: We process personal data in accordance with privacy law (GDPR), and use the data only to administer enrollment, payment and teaching.
To request access, correction or deletion of your data, contact us at baerum@islamskole.no.

sections.heading: Disputes and complaint body
body: The agreement is governed by Norwegian law.

If we cannot reach agreement, you may contact the Norwegian Consumer Council (forbrukerradet.no) for mediation. Disputes may be brought before the ordinary courts, with Asker og Bærum district court as legal venue.
